ClipboardHistory_PluginDesc: Keeps a history of the text, images and copied files on this machine; everything stays local. Type the trigger keyword (default "cb") plus a search term in the search box to find past entries and paste one back with a single click.
ClipboardHistory_PasteElevated: The target window has higher privileges and the current version cannot paste into it
ClipboardHistory_PasteFailed: Paste could not be completed. Choose Copy first, then paste manually into the target window
ClipboardHistory_Config_EnabledDesc: When on, copied plain text is recorded automatically. Turning it off stops recording; existing history is kept.
ClipboardHistory_Config_TriggerKeywordDe: Type this keyword (optionally followed by a space and a search term) in the search box to search clipboard history, e.g. the default "cb".
ClipboardHistory_Config_MaxEntriesDesc: How many entries to keep at most. When the limit is exceeded the oldest entries are removed first (pinned ones are exempt). Minimum 1.
ClipboardHistory_Config_MaxTextLengthDes: How many characters of a single entry to keep, between 1 and 1000000. Anything longer is truncated.
ClipboardHistory_Config_ExcludedProcesse: Text copied while one of these apps is in the foreground is not recorded. Separate process names with commas (no .exe, case-insensitive), e.g. keepass,keepassxc.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_ClipboardTabProvider: Provides the Clipboard tab in the Quick Panel, listing recorded clipboard text entries from newest to oldest.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_ClipboardInstantProvide: Searches recorded clipboard text history from the search box via the trigger keyword (default cb).
Plugin_Comp_Desc_ClipboardActionProvider: Provides paste, copy, pin, delete, source-window and clear-history actions for clipboard entries.
ClipboardHistory_Config_RetentionDesc: Unpinned entries older than this are removed automatically. Pinned entries are kept as long as the history exists.
